text_en: After this Jesus went about in Galilee. He did not wish to go about in Judea because the Jews were looking for an opportunity to kill him.
text_cn: 这些事以后，耶稣周游于加里肋亚，而不愿周游于犹太，因为犹太人要图谋杀害他。

text_en: Now the Jewish festival of Booths was near.
text_cn: 那时，犹太人的庆节，帐棚节近了，

text_en: So his brothers said to him, “Leave here and go to Judea so that your disciples also may see the works you are doing;
text_cn: 他的弟兄于是对他说：“你离开这里，往犹太去罢！好叫你的门徒也看见你所行的事，

text_en: for no one who wants to be widely known acts in secret. If you do these things, show yourself to the world. ”
text_cn: 因为没有人愿意显扬自己，而在暗地里行事的；你既然行这些事，就该将自己显示给世界。”

text_en: (For not even his brothers believed in him. )
text_cn: 原来，连他的弟兄们也不相信他。

text_en: Jesus said to them, “My time has not yet come, but your time is always here.
text_cn: 耶稣回答说：“我的时候还没有到，你们的时候却常是现成的。

text_en: The world cannot hate you, but it hates me because I testify against it that its works are evil.
text_cn: 世界不会恨你们，却是恨我，因为我指证它的行为是邪恶的。

text_en: Go to the festival yourselves. I am not going to this festival, for my time has not yet fully come. ”
text_cn: 你们上去过节罢！我还不上去过这庆节，因为我的时候还没有成熟。”

text_en: After saying this, he remained in Galilee.
text_cn: 他说了这些话后，仍留在加里肋亚。

text_en: But after his brothers had gone to the festival, then he also went, not publicly but as it were in secret.
text_cn: 但他的弟兄们上去过节以后，他也去了，但不是明显的，而是暗中去的。

text_en: The Jews were looking for him at the festival and saying, “Where is he? ”
text_cn: 在庆节中，犹太人寻找他说：“那人在哪里呢？”

text_en: And there was considerable complaining about him among the crowds. While some were saying, “He is a good man, ” others were saying, “No, he is deceiving the crowd. ”
text_cn: 在群众间对他发生了许多私议：有的说：“他是好人”；有的却说：“不，他在煽惑民众”。

text_en: Yet no one would speak openly about him for fear of the Jews.
text_cn: 但是，因为都怕犹太人，谁也不敢公开地讲论他。

text_en: About the middle of the festival Jesus went up into the temple and began to teach.
text_cn: 庆节已过了一半，耶稣就上圣殿里去施教。

text_en: The Jews were astonished at it, saying, “How does this man have such learning, when he has never been taught? ”
text_cn: 犹太人都惊讶说：“这人没有进过学，怎么通晓经书呢？”

text_en: Then Jesus answered them, “My teaching is not mine but his who sent me.
text_cn: 耶稣回答他们说：“我的教训不是我的，而是派遣我来者的。

text_en: Anyone who resolves to do the will of God will know whether the teaching is from God or whether I am speaking on my own.
text_cn: 谁若愿意承行他的旨意，就会认出这教训，是出于天主或由我自己而讲的。

text_en: Those who speak on their own seek their own glory; but the one who seeks the glory of him who sent him is true, and there is nothing false in him.
text_cn: 由自己而讲的，是寻求自己的光荣；但谁若寻求派遣他来者的光荣，他便是诚实的，在他内没有不义。

text_en: “Did not Moses give you the law? Yet none of you keeps the law. Why are you looking for an opportunity to kill me? ”
text_cn: 梅瑟不是曾给你们颁布了法律吗？但你们中却没有一人遵行法律；你们为什么图谋杀害我？”

text_en: The crowd answered, “You have a demon! Who is trying to kill you? ”
text_cn: 群众回答说：“你附了魔；谁图谋杀害你？”

text_en: Jesus answered them, “I performed one work, and all of you are astonished.
text_cn: 耶稣回答说：“我作了一件事，你们就都奇怪。

text_en: Moses gave you circumcision (it is, of course, not from Moses, but from the patriarchs), and you circumcise a man on the sabbath.
text_cn: 梅瑟曾给你们颁定了割损礼──其实并不是由梅瑟，而是由祖先开始的，因此，你们也在安息日给人行割损礼。

text_en: If a man receives circumcision on the sabbath in order that the law of Moses may not be broken, are you angry with me because I healed a man’s whole body on the sabbath?
text_cn: 若是在安息日，为满全梅瑟的法律，人可受割损礼；那么，为了我在安息日，使一个人完全恢复健康，你们就对我发怒么？

text_en: Do not judge by appearances, but judge with right judgment. ”
text_cn: 你们不要按照外表判断，但要按照公义判断”。

text_en: Now some of the people of Jerusalem were saying, “Is not this the man whom they are trying to kill?
text_cn: 于是，有几个耶路撒冷人说：“这不是人们所要图谋杀害的人吗？

text_en: And here he is, speaking openly, but they say nothing to him! Can it be that the authorities really know that this is the Messiah?
text_cn: 看，他放胆地讲论，而没有人对他说什么，难道首长们也确认这人就是默西亚吗？

text_en: Yet we know where this man is from; but when the Messiah comes, no one will know where he is from. ”
text_cn: 可是，我们知道这人是哪里的；然而，当默西亚来时，却没有人知道他是哪里的。”

text_en: Then Jesus cried out as he was teaching in the temple, “You know me, and you know where I am from. I have not come on my own. But the one who sent me is true, and you do not know him.
text_cn: 于是耶稣在圣殿施教时，大声喊说：“你们认识我，也知道我是哪里的；但我不是由我自己而来，而是那真实者派遣我来的，你们却不认识他；

text_en: I know him, because I am from him, and he sent me. ”
text_cn: 我认识他，因为我是出于他，是他派遣了我。”

text_en: Then they tried to arrest him, but no one laid hands on him, because his hour had not yet come.
text_cn: 他们想捉住他，但没有人向他下手，因为他的时辰还没有到。

text_en: Yet many in the crowd believed in him and were saying, “When the Messiah comes, will he do more signs than this man has done? ”
text_cn: 群众中有许多人信了他，且说：“默西亚来时，难道会行比这人更多的奇迹吗？”

text_en: The Pharisees heard the crowd muttering such things about him, and the chief priests and Pharisees sent temple police to arrest him.
text_cn: 法利塞人听见群众对耶稣这样议论纷纷，司祭长和法利塞人便派遣差役去捉拿他。

text_en: Jesus then said, “I will be with you a little while longer, and then I am going to him who sent me.
text_cn: 于是耶稣说：“我和你们同在的时候不多了，我要回到派遣我来的那里去。

text_en: You will search for me, but you will not find me; and where I am, you cannot come. ”
text_cn: 你们要找我，却找不着；而我所在的地方，你们也不能去。”

text_en: The Jews said to one another, “Where does this man intend to go that we will not find him? Does he intend to go to the Dispersion among the Greeks and teach the Greeks?
text_cn: 犹太人便彼此说：“这人要往哪里去，我们找不着他呢？难道他要往散居在希腊民中的犹太人那里去，教训希腊人么？

text_en: What does he mean by saying, ‘You will search for me and you will not find me’ and ‘Where I am, you cannot come’? ”
text_cn: 他所说：‘你们要找我，却找不着；我所在的地方，你们也不能去’的这话，是什么意思？”

text_en: On the last day of the festival, the great day, while Jesus was standing there, he cried out, “Let anyone who is thirsty come to me,
text_cn: 在庆节末日最隆重的那一天，耶稣站着大声喊说：“谁若渴，到我这里来喝罢！

text_en: and let the one who believes in me drink. As the scripture has said, ‘Out of the believer’s heart shall flow rivers of living water. ’”
text_cn: 凡信从我的，就如经上说：从他的心中要流出活水的江河。”

text_en: Now he said this about the Spirit, which believers in him were to receive; for as yet there was no Spirit, because Jesus was not yet glorified.
text_cn: 他说这话，是指那信仰他的人将要领受的圣神；圣神还没有赐下，因为耶稣还没有受到光荣。

text_en: When they heard these words, some in the crowd said, “This is really the prophet. ”
text_cn: 群众中有些人听了这些话，便说：“这人真是那位先知。”

text_en: Others said, “This is the Messiah. ” But some asked, “Surely the Messiah does not come from Galilee, does he?
text_cn: 另有些人说：“这人是默西亚。”但也有人说：“难道默西亚能来自加里肋亚吗？

text_en: Has not the scripture said that the Messiah is descended from David and comes from Bethlehem, the village where David lived? ”
text_cn: 经上不是说：默西亚要出自达味的后裔，来自达味出生的村庄白冷吗？”

text_en: So there was a division in the crowd because of him.
text_cn: 因此，为了耶稣的缘故，在群众中起了纷争。

text_en: Some of them wanted to arrest him, but no one laid hands on him.
text_cn: 他们中有些人愿捉拿他，但谁也没有向他下手。

text_en: Then the temple police went back to the chief priests and Pharisees, who asked them, “Why did you not arrest him? ”
text_cn: 差役回到司祭长和法利塞人那里；司祭长和法利塞人问他们说：“为什么你们没有把他带来？”

text_en: The police answered, “Never has anyone spoken like this! ”
text_cn: 差役回答说：“从来没有一个人如此讲话，像这人讲话一样。”

text_en: Then the Pharisees replied, “Surely you have not been deceived too, have you?
text_cn: 法利塞人遂向他们说：“难道你们也受了煽惑吗？

text_en: Has any one of the authorities or of the Pharisees believed in him?
text_cn: 首长中或法利塞人中，难道有人信仰了他吗？

text_en: But this crowd, which does not know the law—they are accursed. ”
text_cn: 但是，这些不明白法律的群众，是可诅咒的！”

text_en: Nicodemus, who had gone to Jesus before, and who was one of them, asked,
text_cn: 他们中有一个，即先前曾来到耶稣那里的尼苛德摩，遂向他们说：

text_en: “Our law does not judge people without first giving them a hearing to find out what they are doing, does it? ”
text_cn: “如果不先听取人的口供，和查明他所作的事，难道我们的法律就许定他的罪么？”

text_en: They replied, “Surely you are not also from Galilee, are you? Search and you will see that no prophet is to arise from Galilee. ” [[
text_cn: 他们回答他说：“难道你也是出自加里肋亚么？你去查考，你就能知道：从加里肋亚不会出先知的。”

text_en: Then each of them went home,
text_cn: 然后，他们就各自回家去了。
